spec.rawSql:
select
  conflicted_file.path as submodule,
  case
    when conflicted_file.stage = 1 then 'base'
    when conflicted_file.stage = 2 then 'ours'
    else 'theirs'
  end as stage,
  conflicted_file.oid as commit
from
  redis_json array
  join content.merge_result.conflicted_files::Array(JSON) as conflicted_file
where
  key = 'info:conflict:core:${repo_name}:${merge}'
  and conflicted_file.mode = '160000'

SELECT content.duration_seconds::float as "Resolution Duration"
FROM "default"."redis_json"
where key = 'evaluation:merge:core:${repo_name}-${merge}:${timestamp}'

SELECT
  case
    when content.incomplete_merge = false then 1
    else 0
  end as "Complete Merge",
  case
    when content.perfect_match = false then 0
    else 1
  end as "Perfect Match"
FROM
  "default"."redis_json"
where
  key = 'evaluation:merge:core:${repo_name}-${merge}:${timestamp}'

SELECT
    distinct message.info.modelID as Model
FROM "default"."redis_json"
array join content.hook_result.opencode_session_export.data.messages::Array(JSON) as message
array join message.parts::Array(JSON) as part
where key = 'resolution:conflict:${repo_name}-${merge}:${timestamp}'
and message.info.role = 'assistant' 
and part.type not like 'step-%'

SELECT
    distinct content.failure_summary as "Resolution Failure Summary"
FROM "default"."redis_json"
where key = 'evaluation:merge:summary:${repo_name}-${merge}:${timestamp}'

with base as (
SELECT 
logical_conflict.logical_conflict_index,
logical_conflict.status,
arrayStringConcat(coalesce(logical_conflict.agent_classifications, []), '\n') as agentClassification,
arrayStringConcat(coalesce(logical_conflict.human_classifications, []), '\n') as humanClassification
FROM "default"."redis_json"
array join content.logical_conflicts::Array(JSON) as logical_conflict
where key = 'evaluation:merge:classification:${repo_name}-${merge}:${timestamp}'
)
select *, (humanClassification = agentClassification)::boolean as exact_match from base

SELECT
    now(),
    CASE 
        WHEN part.type = 'text' THEN 
            part.text
        WHEN part.type = 'patch' THEN 
            part.files::text
        WHEN part.type = 'tool' THEN 
            concat(coalesce(part.state.title, ''), ' | Command: ', coalesce(part.state.input.command, ''))
        ELSE concat('[UNUSUAL TYPE: ', part.type, ']')
    END AS log_line,
    upper(part.type) as part_type
FROM "default"."redis_json"
array join content.hook_result.opencode_session_export.data.messages::Array(JSON) as message
array join message.parts::Array(JSON) as part
where key = 'resolution:conflict:${repo_name}-${merge}:${timestamp}'
and message.info.role = 'assistant' 
and part.type not like 'step-%'

SELECT
    --fromUnixTimestamp(message.info.time.created::integer),
    now(),
    CASE 
        WHEN part.tool = 'read' or part.tool = 'edit' THEN 
            basename(part.state.input.filePath)
        WHEN part.tool = 'bash' THEN 
            part.state.input.command
        ELSE concat('[UNUSUAL Tool: ', part.tool, ']')
    END AS log_line,
    part.tool as part_tool
FROM "default"."redis_json"
array join content.hook_result.opencode_session_export.data.messages::Array(JSON) as message
array join message.parts::Array(JSON) as part
where key = 'resolution:conflict:${repo_name}-${merge}:${timestamp}'
and message.info.role = 'assistant' 
and part.type = 'tool'

SELECT
  now(), content.proposed_to_actual_resolution_raw
FROM "default"."redis_json"
where key = 'evaluation:merge:diff:${repo_name}-${merge}:${timestamp}'

select key, logical_conflict.type, logical_conflict.info, logical_conflict.paths  from redis_json
array join content.merge_result.logical_conflicts::Array(JSON) as logical_conflict
where key = 'info:conflict:core:${repo_name}:${merge}'

select
  conflicted_file.path,
  case
    when conflicted_file.stage = 1 then 'base'
    when conflicted_file.stage = 2 then 'ours'
    else 'theirs'
  end as stage,
  conflicted_file.mode
from
  redis_json array
  join content.merge_result.conflicted_files::Array(JSON) as conflicted_file
where
  key = 'info:conflict:core:${repo_name}:${merge}'
  and conflicted_file.mode != '160000'

SELECT
  content.resolution_end::datetime,
  content.proposed_resolution.error
FROM "default"."redis_json"
where key = 'resolution:conflict:${repo_name}-${merge}:${timestamp}'

spec.definition:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    key,
    extractGroups (
      arrayElement(splitByString('resolution:conflict:', key), 2),
      '(.+)\.git-([a-f0-9]{40}):(.*)$'
    ) AS groups
  FROM
    "default"."redis_json"
  WHERE
    startsWith(key, 'resolution')
    AND content.proposed_resolution.error IS NULL
)
SELECT
  groups[3] AS timestamp
FROM
  base
WHERE
    concat(groups[1], '.git') = '${repo_name}'  -- <-- Replace with your target repo (e.g., 'framework.git')
  AND groups[2] = '${merge}'    -- <-- Replace with your target merge commit hash
ORDER BY
  timestamp DESC;
